'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 John Veasey DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
